subject: adding a class to a selectInput for shiny .11

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: adding a class to a selectInput for shiny .11
parts:
A selectInput with multiple=TRUE and selectize=FALSE does not have the same styling as other elements in Shiny .11. Adding the class "form-control" should fix this. I have tried the work-arounds below from .js file in www/. I source another js file in the same way for drag-and-drop in selectize so I don't think there is a problem there. The 2nd and 3rd options work from the js console but not when sourced using includeScript. Any suggestions for a work-around?

document.getElementsByTagName("select[multiple]").className += " form-control";

document.getElementById("vizvars1").className += " form-control";

$('#vizvars1').addClass('form-control');
